provenance: RECORD-TIER anchor (019 doctrine: deviations are reported, never gated). Single-session first-hand measurement, 2026-07-11, owner's Diamond Pro-Am 9-ft (catalog geometry diamond_proam_9ft, independently confirmed by the diamond-sight homography at 0.33-0.38 mm RMS), one uncharacterized cue, one striped training ball standing in for the cue ball; iPhone slow-motion VFR originals on the exact per-frame pts clock (pipeline v3 definitive; v1/v2 bake-clock numbers retracted). Full session, method, uncertainty and adjudication record: docs/verification/pool-9ft-measured-calibration.md (audit trail: GitHub issue #5). Anti-overfit doctrine (constitution P-IV): this data legitimizes ONLY the opt-in Measured-tier catalog entries (owner_proam_9ft_2026_07 / owner_proam_cloth_2026_07) and these record-tier anchors; it is NEVER grounds to change global kernel defaults. KNOWN GAP carried on every english cell: ball spin omega was not measured anywhere in Set A - 'run'/'rev' are slate-confirmed ~0.4R tip-offset protocol labels, so any model comparison MUST derive the english-cell arrival spin from the 0.4R tip-offset strike protocol via the kernel's own cue model + cloth transport; e_normal/f_tangential are velocity-component proxies, not spin-decomposed cushion coefficients.

metadata.pipeline_version: v3 (camera VFR originals; per-frame pts_time is the time base; no slow factor, no dup handling)

method.timeline: exact per-frame pts (VFR ~75% 1/240s + ~25% 1/80s, finely interleaved); cuts decoded with -fps_mode passthrough; decoded frame count == cut pts>=0 count verified for all 25 cuts; frame k <-> k-th pts
method.tracking: v1 HSV colored-stripe centroid + white-disk fallback at half-res, plus v3 additions: box-sum big-blob suppression (owner/arm/cue), interior acquisition gate, lock area cap; 3 shots re-tracked with per-frame independent cluster extraction + bidirectional coherence linking from a manual anchor (IMG_4277-s09, IMG_4278-s07, IMG_4278-s12)
method.geometry: v2 diamond-sight rectification method re-fit on v3 median backgrounds: 17 sights on the L/8=317.5mm grid of the 2540x1270mm nose rect, alternating DLT/offset solve; fit RMS 0.35mm (4277) / 0.33mm (4278); corner positions within 0.2px of the v2 bake-era fit (same rig confirmed); ball-plane parallax factor 1.00536 applied to speeds
method.extraction: identical event logic and physical windows as v2: first cushion contact via normal-distance vertex fit; robust quadratic legs over <=0.7s real (= v2's 0.28s bake-clock) with 0.05s guard; velocity thresholds converted by the confirmed 2.498 clock factor; NEW: address-rest points excluded from incoming legs (fast shots' launch gate can fire ~0.07s early)
method.uncertainty: cell spread = std over 4 repeats; speed scale systematic +-0.3% (catalog sight grid + rail-plane/ball-plane parallax with camera height 2.73+-0.15m); angle window-sensitivity typically <2deg (slow outgoing legs up to ~10deg on individual shots due to post-cushion curvature - cell std covers it)
method.timeline_50deg_note: exact per-frame pts (VFR ~75% 1/240s + ~25% 1/80s, finely interleaved); cuts decoded with -fps_mode passthrough; decoded frame count == pts count verified for all 24 cuts; frame k <-> k-th pts. PTS GOTCHA: IMG_4280 cuts are rebased (leading RASL packets have negative pts, packet-level pts>=0 filter correct); IMG_4279 cuts keep SOURCE-ABSOLUTE pts (RASL packets positive, still decoder-dropped) -> FRAME-level ffprobe pts used there (e.g. s01: 1416 packets vs 1413 decoded frames). IMG_4279 track clocks are source-absolute.

scale_source.30deg: homography from the 18 diamond sights (17 used; L/8 = 317.5 mm catalog grid, owner-confirmed Diamond Pro-Am 9ft), re-fit on v3 original frames; fit RMS 0.33-0.35 mm; ball 57.15 mm assumed for the plane-parallax factor only (fit RMS 0.35 mm IMG_4277 / 0.33 mm IMG_4278)
scale_source.50deg: homography from diamond sights (17 used; L/8 = 317.5 mm catalog grid, owner-confirmed Diamond Pro-Am 9ft), re-fit on v3 original frames; ball 57.15 mm assumed for plane-parallax factor only (fit RMS 0.36 mm IMG_4279 / 0.38 mm IMG_4280)
scale_source.speed_scale_systematic: +-0.3% (catalog sight grid + rail-plane/ball-plane parallax, camera height 2.73+-0.15 m; parallax factor 1.00536 applied)

metadata.angle_convention: angles measured from the cushion normal; theta_out_minus_in positive = rebound more tangential (bank runs long), negative = steeper (bank shortens); cell spread = std over 4 repeats (ddof=1)

known_limitations: SPIN OMEGA NOT MEASURED for any cell (stripe-phase extraction not attempted). The english cells ('run'/'rev') are protocol labels only: slate-confirmed strikes at ~0.4R tip offset. Any cushion-model fit against these cells MUST model the english-cell arrival spin state from the 0.4R tip-offset strike protocol (cue speed + tip offset -> squirt/spin -> cloth transport to the cushion); do NOT treat these cells as measured-spin data.
e_normal and f_tangential are velocity-component PROXIES only (vn_out/vn_in and vt_out/vt_in); a cushion friction vs slip-velocity decomposition needs omega and is not possible from this set.
'fast' is a speed band, not a point: v_in spans ~2.3-4.5 m/s across fast-cell shots; 'slow' spans ~0.7-1.1 m/s.
angle window-sensitivity typically <2 deg; slow outgoing legs up to ~10 deg on individual shots due to post-cushion curvature (cell std covers it).
arrival spin state is unmeasured even for 'none' cells (slow cells plausibly arrive near-rolling; not verified).
